Thanks for the call — notes below and next steps.

Meeting notes (condensed):
- Compatibility: Redwood runtime is agnostic to LangChain/LlamaIndex as long as the SDK passes the call_id header and avoids altering the KV cache keyspace.
- Batching: We recommend letting Redwood handle final batching for latency sensitive paths; expose a single-call pattern in your SDK for low-latency fallbacks.
- Quantization: Acceptable route is to expose a model selection policy (customer-facing) with an automatic fallback to a smaller variant if capacity/constrained. We will publish a recommended list of model variants that we’ve validated.
- Telemetry: Map your trace spans to redwood.trace_id and emit token attribution rows labeled with customer_id + call_id.

Owner assignments:
- Olga: publish interop checklist (today) + internal acceptance test template.
- Mateo: draft runtime shim PR with example mapping (next week).
- Vanessa: commercial touchpoint; review SOW and propose pricing band.

3) Mateo and Evan to pair on a shim prototype (target PR by 7/26).

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.
